ValidationRule.description: Validation for Non Bahraini Nationality for Residency Permit
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.LastName <> 'Integration', ISCHANGED(Nationality__pc), OR( Residency_Permit_Expiry__pc < Today()+10, ISBLANK(Residency_Permit_Expiry__pc) ), Nationality__pc <>'BH' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Residency Permit should be valid for at least 10 days.
